steps.name: Gendia's Letter
steps.objective: Go from “Quartz Cave” to “Drullage Village” and talk to Levy.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Oh, Adventurer must be… . You are %s. The person who helped His Majesty solve the Yongje Castle Incident... .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: My name is Levitation, and I am the Inspector General of the Ziendia Empire.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Judging by the look on your face, you were taken aback when you heard your name. Because many people reacted that way.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Yes, I only have the same name as him, but my last name is different.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I see. I don’t even know that… .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: It's okay. Let me introduce you again.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: This is Levy, the eldest son of the Syation family of the Giandia Empire.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Your Majesty spoke a lot. What a wonderful Adventurer poem... .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: It is an honor to meet Adventurer like this.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Additionally, I would like to express my gratitude on behalf of Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Because Adventurer's dedication will save and save countless innocent lives... .

steps.name: What Happened to Drulidge Village?
steps.objective: Complete the quest and hear the detailed story from Ferdinand in “Druliji Village”.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I heard that Adventurer would help the investigation team. I have a lot of work to do right now because the situation here is not good.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: So, %s, let me get to the point.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Our investigation team, or rather the inspection team, discovered traces of magic stones here near Drulidge Village. I couldn't figure out why the traces of the magic stone from Yongje Castle were here.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: While continuing to investigate, I learned that a twin-headed ogre named Geminus was leading an ogre army and threatening Drullizi.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: If Drullizi falls, the entire Mirgandia region could become dangerous, so we decided to join forces with a nearby mercenary group.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: We split up our team to search for the source of the magic stone and deal with the ogre unit.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: And thanks to the mercenaries, we were able to discover the magic stone fragment. There was a lot of help from a person in the mercenary group who was not a magician but was somewhat knowledgeable.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: However, in the process, there was an attack by an ogre army, and the village suffered damage while trying to stop them.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: The first thing to do is to get this Drullizi. Only then will we be able to continue the investigation.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I'm glad %s came during this difficult time.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: So can you help me? Of course, if you help us, we will provide you with the information you want.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Map where Iris is….)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: What are you thinking like that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. Let me help you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I made a promise to His Majesty, so... .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Thank you. As expected, you are exactly as your Majesty said. You can hear the detailed story by visiting Ferdinand.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I'm sorry I can't come with you because I have some work to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. It can't be helped.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I will go to the person you mentioned.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Then, please.

steps.name: Oscuras Mercenaries
steps.objective: Complete the quest from Parmilla in “Drulizi Village”.

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Introduce yourself briefly to Ferdinand. Then Ferdinand nods as if he understands.)

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: The residents of this village are all druids. They are a clan that believes in and follows nature, and after searching for a place with the purest energy, they settled here.

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: So we were happy for 100 years. However, the reason the village became anxious was because of the twin-headed ogre Geminus, who appeared from the north a year ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's a twin-headed ogre... .

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: A misshapen ogre with two heads. I didn't even know there was such an ogre in Myrgandia.

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: Geminus grew in power by subduing monsters and various other races in the area by force, and forced us, humans, to make a choice.

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: They say you too will be ruled by power... . So I ask you to choose whether to die or surrender.

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: How could a human being submit to such a monster that has no dignity whatsoever?

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: So we decided to hold out and defended the village from them for a long time.

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: However, because our best warrior, Cloud, was injured, we lost more days.

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: … I'm embarrassed to say this to a stranger, but I guess it can't be helped. For someone who says they will help us... .

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: So, I asked for help from the Oscuras mercenary group I had a connection with.

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: It worked well because Geminus's monster troops were gradually increasing, but it was still not enough to deal with them.

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: Just in time, the inspection team of the Ziendia Empire appeared, and you, the great Adventurer, came.

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: This has happened thanks to everyone's efforts, but it's still not enough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There was such a situation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what can I do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I just take care of all the monsters?

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: Hmm… . It is not a problem that can be handled simply.

lines.speaker: 페르디난드
lines.text: It would be better to discuss this matter with the leader of the Oscuras mercenaries rather than with me. Although she is a young girl, she is a person with great mercenary skills in handling people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, then I will go to Parmilla.

steps.name: forest of mushrooms
steps.objective: Defeat the [Night Dragon] and [Five Dragon] in the "Mushroom Forest" and complete the quest from Varmun.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hey, %s, it's been a while. Did you hear the story from the village chief? Then, let me explain what we just did, how we got there, and how we did it.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Our member Varmun found a magic stone in the mushroom forest. To be precise, it was a monster with a magic stone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you get a magic stone from a monster?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: This is getting a bit complicated. Currently, we are working on several projects in cooperation with the Empire and the Druid Village.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: The first is securing the forest boundaries and areas for mushrooms.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: The second is the border of the destroyed castle, the source of Geminus and the monster army.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Lastly, the third thing is to trace the source of the magic stone.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Currently, the Imperial Inspection Team is helping with security, so we're in charge of that job.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: We do what we do, they do what we do. It's a matter of mutual interest. It's kind of a deal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something is complicated. So what should I do?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hmm, wait a minute. Since you have now received a request from the Empire, I don't think you are doing our work.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: You may think you just need to find the source of the magic stone, but...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Oh, I don't know. First, I want you to stop Geminus' minions. It'll just take a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Do you need to worry? If it's unclear, go to the head of the imperial inspection team and talk again.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Otherwise, go immediately to the border area of the Mushroom Forest. There are mercenary barmun and druid warrior Herace. Go and help them.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: As the number of monsters continues to increase, it will be difficult with just those two.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: … Are you going to help me? Of course, I'll give an example. There are a lot of things to do to get money here and there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard your story. Should I help you?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hehe, I thought you would help me.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: When you enter the forest, you will see monsters, but don't leave them alone. They're all Geminus' subordinates.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: So be careful. The stories about ogres being stupid and ignorant are all old stories. Okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for your concern, Parmilla. Then I'll come back.

steps.name: Find the source of the magic stone
steps.objective: Defeat [Topaz Cameron] in “Mushroom Forest” and acquire <Dark Magic Stone Fragment>.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: You are here. Since this is a situation, I will explain it right away. The area where the magic stone was discovered is right here, the Mushroom Forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, please explain.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: It can be said that all races in this region obeyed Geminus. They keep attacking humans whenever they see them, so we do our best to deal with them as we see them.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Then, something strange happened. I saw the object that fell after defeating a particularly strong hobgoblin... . It was a magic stone.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: I don't know what type of magic stone it was, but it seemed to amplify the goblin's power.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: I collected samples and kept them, and then the Imperial Inspection Team showed up.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Have you met a person named Levitation? He has an appearance that women like.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think many people besides me think that way.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Do people like that have a complex about their looks?

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Hehe, I wish I had it. That way, people like us will feel less unfair!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We… yo. this?

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Just kidding, kidding.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No, why does the story flow like that?)

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Well, it's frustrating because I don't know where the magic stone originates.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: First, all we have to do is investigate the monsters around here and find them. It's a stupid method, but it's the best.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: If you trace the area where it appears, you might be able to find out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess I don't have as much time as I think. I need to hurry.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Then I will take charge of that side. %s, please take the opposite direction.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then be careful with Barmun too.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Of course!

steps.name: Druid Warrior Herace
steps.objective: Go to Hereis near the “Hidden Cave”.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you discover something?

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: No… . I dealt with the monsters that rushed at me like this, but there wasn't much of a clue... .

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: I really don't know. Aren’t the monsters around here the minions of Geminus?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you saying there could be another force?

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: I think that might be the case. Hmm, what would you like to do? I guess I'll have to go somewhere else to find out... .

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Did you hear that there was someone else out there besides me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that warrior?

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Herace… , self-proclaimed supreme druid warrior. It seems that way to me. That guy called Cloud seemed stronger... .

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: (Barmun looks angry at Hereis.)

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: I will be here, so if you want to go, go alone. Because I don’t want to run into that person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Did something bad happen?

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: They growl at me and tell me not to approach the women in the village.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: How do you see people... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: I was just praising the beauty of the Druid girls.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: He got angry because he couldn't even understand the situation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think that can happen.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Well, anyway, I will continue to look for magic stones that drop from monsters here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Then, I will go to where Hereis is.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Let's leave this to Varmun and quickly find Herace.)

steps.name: I need a cure
steps.objective: Defeat the [Spot Bubble] in “Mushroom Forest” and collect <Slime>.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: I have to go to town quickly, but with a body like this… . Ugh… , clack, clack.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Who, who are you?

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: How did we get here? It's my first time seeing this face... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're Hereis from Drullizi Village, right?

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: … Seeing as how you know my name... . Obviously… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Herace about how you came here.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't be too guarded. I'm here to help.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Pretending to help our village, we're working for an empire on a distant continent looking for magic stones, but are you telling us not to be cautious? Interesting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: I know what you mean. Anyway, I'm glad it's not an enemy.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Whatever it is, help me now. I'm injured now and can't move.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Cluck, cluck… .

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: I want you to get some slime from the spot bubbles wandering around the forest.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: If you have that, you can quickly make a cure. Cluck cluck… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, I see. Then just stay here. I'll be back soon.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Thank you. Cluck, cluck.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: What an interesting foreigner... . Cluck, cluck… .

steps.name: hidden in the cave
steps.objective: “Hidden Cave” Defeat [Nepandus] and acquire the <Suspicious Journal>, and report it to [Hereis] in front of the “Hidden Cave”.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Thank you. Thanks to this, the wound healed a little.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: … Then I'll tell you what you're curious about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, go ahead.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: The source of magic stones... .

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Listen carefully. Concentrate.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: That cave is a ‘hidden cave’ that appeared a while ago.  That place can be said to be the source of the magic stone.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: It is full of monsters that contain magic stones, and there is a being that moves those monsters.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: It’s Rich… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute? Rich?

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Yes, a black magician who turned himself into undead for immortality.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: The name is unknown, but there is no doubt that the lich is related to the magic stone.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: A person who was close to the peak of black magic would have made himself a lich. The magic stone must have been created using knowledge of black magic.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: The magic stones found around here seem to have been influenced by black magic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Herace, the dark sage, the injury was caused by Lich... .

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: It's a shame. A Drulligi warrior like this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even Lich doesn't seem like an average opponent... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, if you kill him, you will get a clue about making magic stones, right?

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Are you really planning on dealing with Lich? It's a foolish choice. I'm the guy who couldn't handle it either... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still, I have to try it. Because if you don't do it, you won't be able to find out anything.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Are you saying you want to go in there now? If that's the case, I won't stop you, but... .

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Please be careful. Don't take things lightly inside that cave.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, then I'll go in and look for that lich.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: You're back. Does that mean you defeated the lich?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it was a little difficult. I found this book there, would you like to take a look?

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Book?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The cover of the book says 'Nephandus', so that's probably the name of the lich, right?

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: It's the black magician Nephandus... . So you have no choice but to be strong.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: He was a dangerous person who, hundreds of years ago, wanted to create a kingdom of darkness. He was threatening everyone with black magic, and even necromancy.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: I don't know about you, but there was a big conflict in Freios a long time ago. Nephandus tried to use that time to become king himself.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: However, several powers, including the kingdom that was the predecessor of the current Sylvaria Empire, noticed this and formed an alliance to subdue Nephandus.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: I heard that he was defeated by the Allied Forces and disappeared... . I never thought that time would pass like this and I would end up in the form of a lich.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something like that happened.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: This is the final answer of a foolish person who rejected the providence of the world and turned into an undead...

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Anyway, you had a lot of trouble.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: This booklet will contain the information you want... .

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Go and report to the man named Levi.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it okay for Hereis not to return to the village?

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Are you worried about me? That's funny. Focus on your work rather than mine.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: I'll continue to check the situation in that cave, so go back quickly. Because they will be waiting for you there too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 헤레이스
lines.text: Got it. Well then, good luck.

steps.name: another favor
steps.objective: Go to Arcane near the "Destroyed Castle".

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Hmm, that's what this book is about. At a glance, it appears to be a journal in which Nepandus records his current situation and research results.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Let me take a closer look and tell you.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: (Levi checks the contents of the book with a serious expression for a while.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does it contain?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: There is no doubt that Nephandus created the magic stone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. What next?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: It seems that Nephandus' magic stone was used to break through the Dragon Emperor Castle's barrier.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It goes like this.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: However, since Nepandus didn't do it himself, I think I'll have to look further.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … That means I saw it at Yongje Castle... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that the Agashura man with long red hair?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Yes, you know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, is that story in this book?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Obviously, Kii also talked about that person.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Looking at this book, it seems like Nepandus died while hiding in a cave.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I don't know why it didn't come back, but something must have happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I briefly heard the story of Nepandus from Hereis. He was defeated by the Allied Forces and disappeared into a cave... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how did you become a lich?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: The Agashura man resurrected him from the dead, and the resurrected lich did his bidding.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Even though I became a rich person, I can't seem to get rid of the habit of writing things down. It's all written here. Anyway, I will report based on this information.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: In the meantime, Adventurer would like you to help the mercenaries with their work. I heard that ogre movements were already detected in that castle, so I investigated... .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: It seems that Geminus is using it as its home base. This is the [Destroyed Castle] on the outskirts of the Mushroom Forest.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: The mercenaries are on guard, but they seem to be having a hard time. If %s joins... It will probably be of great help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll come back. Don't worry too much.

steps.name: Master of the Monster Army
steps.objective: Defeat [Geminus] in the "Destroyed Castle" and report to [Arcane] in front of the castle.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: %s, it’s been a while.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: They said support would come, so I waited and %s… , unexpected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while. Mr. Arcane. I'm glad you're doing well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, please explain the current situation.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: I'm relieved that you're here, but it's definitely hard to explain.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Dealing with Geminus is dealing with it, but there are also circumstances in the village.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: First of all, how much do you know about the village and our situation?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, a little bit.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Then the story will be faster.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Right now, we're having a hard time just defending against the monster troops. It can't be like this forever... . So I made a choice.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: raid. However, there is no one skilled enough to do that.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Everyone has skills, but they lack the experience to deal with monsters like this.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: I don't know if it's the colleagues who followed the previous leader, but the current situation is not enough.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: But thank you for coming to help me like this.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: I think you can take on that twin-headed ogre, Geminus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm scared when you say that, but can I do it?

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: You can definitely do it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came here thinking I could only help a little.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: I'll give you some information that may be helpful for your scam. At this hour, the ogres are quiet. Now is a golden opportunity.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: I'll take care of the ogres that come out from here, so you can take care of the inside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Since you say so, I will come and meet Geminus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…then let’s go….)

lines.speaker: 게미누스
lines.text: Ugh… . Ugh… . Human, you are strong. You could kill me if you wanted to, so why don't you do it?

lines.speaker: 게미누스
lines.text: … There's a lot on your face that you want to know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Geminus, where do you come from? Why did you raise an army here and attack the human village?

lines.speaker: 게미누스
lines.text: Do you think I will respond to that kind of thing smoothly?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm full of doubts when I see the twin-headed ogre that I didn't even know where it was until now.

lines.speaker: 게미누스
lines.text: I simply follow the Creator's commands... . He won't answer unless it's what he wants.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Creator?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Could it be that it was created?)

lines.speaker: 게미누스
lines.text: (Geminus does not respond. His body gradually becomes stiff due to the action of some force.)

lines.speaker: 게미누스
lines.text: (No life is felt in Geminus' body.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What... ? What on earth is going on?

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Geminus said that? Hmm… . I'm sure you're not talking about a real creator god... .

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: It's difficult. They say that someone forcibly created a twin-headed ogre called Geminus through an experiment... .

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Who on earth planned such a thing... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I doubt that too. Why on earth do they do that in Mirgandia?

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: I'm not sure, but maybe it's because Nepandus is here?

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: The person who created Geminus must have come here because he wanted something.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: For some reason, they wanted to base it on Mirgandia. I created Geminus to lead an army of monsters, and I needed a land for them to stay... … .

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: So I instructed Geminus to do that. Drullizi happened to be in the way... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels like something that was broken is being put together.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Anyway, now that the leader is defeated, everything else will work out. Thank you, Geminus has been resolved and my frustration is gone.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: We'll take care of the rest, so you can report this to our leader.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: It was really hard. See you later then.

steps.name: New request?
steps.objective: Complete the quest from Levy in “Drullidge Village”.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: (Parmilla is puzzled after hearing about what happened in the mushroom forest and the destroyed castle from %s.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I see. Nephandus and Geminus, it seems like there is a connection.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: After listening to Arcane, it seems like that.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Nephandus is resurrected, Geminus is created... . After all, there must be something, right?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Thanks to you, I think Drullizi will be more comfortable. Because the great danger has disappeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I think I can take a little rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong, Parmilla?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… . Still sorting things out.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: That's right. I really hate to imagine this, but what if? If you were planning to turn Drullizi into a magic stone laboratory or military base... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Doesn't that make enough sense?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I definitely think so. But it's okay because it's not now, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That person's goal is over.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: … It seems like he's secretly bragging that it ended because of him?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rather than self-praise... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought it was okay since Parmilla approved it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The druids and mercenaries have joined forces, and I have also joined forces, so what is this? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel like I've grown more than before.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But why do you look at it that way?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: (Parmilla is looking at %s's face with strange eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Parmilla, why aren’t you saying anything?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: (Parmilla nods without saying a word.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Parmilla? Did I do something wrong?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: No, no. Go to Levy and tell him what you have experienced so far.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Good job. Hehehe. See you later then. First of all, it looks like our mercenary group will have to return to the garrison as soon as it is organized.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I will go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Parmilla waves goodbye to %s.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It worked out well this time, but what on earth does His Majesty, the Emperor of the Sylvaria Empire, think? .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: And even if the continent of Gendia is like that... .
